upper_bound.witness: MISSING STATEMENT: a proof that for arbitrary disjoint collections A, B of initial intervals with arbitrary lengths, the overlay of the concatenated B-row onto the initial length-q segment of the concatenated A-row can be realized with at most |A|+|B|-1 new cuts placed inside the intervals (i.e. at most |B|-1 mapped B-division points plus the boundary point q in the A-row, and at most |A|-1 mapped A-division points in the B-row). The quoted passage only names the overlay idea and explicitly defers the counting that establishes bound (5); no case analysis, no accounting of which division points require cuts, and no treatment of coincidences with existing interval endpoints is given.
upper_bound.load_bearing: The whole upper bound rests on Xiang using at most n marks: the total-cut computation (13) ((|A|+|B|-1)+(n+1-|A|-|B|)=n) is exactly the deferred bound (5), so without it Xiang's reply may exceed n marks and D<=d is not established for every Liu division.
